selection_access: Neither the 15 retail fruit faces nor the seven decayed fruit targets may be run through a classifier before freezing the single development-selected challenger.
units: Report 15 visible-normal crops in four variety groups, seven obvious visible-decay single-target crops from seven photographers, and the one reserved Penn minor from the separate date. No pooling across sources or estimation of prevalence.
rule: Evaluate the same fixed three-grade decision and unchanged photo preprocessing on the previous Woo reference and frozen challenger. Report original-to-new counts and names for any severe-to-good errors, including errors already present with Woo. Counts cannot certify a zero population risk.
